headline: Never Stop Thinking reports continuous-time language agents and tests verifiable training signals
summary: The paper introduces a text-first voice-agent design that keeps one reasoning stream active while speech, tool results and interruptions arrive, using an interrupt-and-resume orchestrator without changing model weights. It reports a 19% mean latency reduction on a small composed live pipeline and introduces ReactiveBench, where LLM-judge quality rankings reverse under an independent judge and objective checklists expose task-completion losses from some judge-trained variants. The authors report better streaming correctness from type-shaped verifiable rewards optimized on-policy, including a three-seed 73±5% result and a second-model replication. Results are author-reported; the paper also finds mixed effects across models and conditions, and its live latency set is small and composition-based.
